_readme: Ground truth for app/obs.js and app/action.js, recorded from the LIVE mjlab training envs by tools/export_obs_fixture.py. `robots.<r>` holds exactly the entity quantities app/physics.js exposes; `actor` is what the env's ObservationManager produced from them; `target` is the v25 increment integrator's persistent target after applying `actionIn`. Step 0 is the post-reset frame (episodeLengthBuf 0, raw action zeros).
